messages:
Maya (PM): Prototype uploaded: personalized sample projects strip + small consent toggle in onboarding footer. Two display options: compact pill list (horizontal, avatars + short desc) or expanded cards (image, 2-line blurb). Also considering automatic role detection (dev/product/platform) to surface relevant templates. Link: https://figma.redwood/personalized-samples

Ivy (Design): I prefer compact pills for first-run — less visual noise and fits near the setup checklist. Cards feel heavyweight and push the checklist below the fold on small screens. Attached prototype shows pill hover and long-press reveal for mobile.

Carlos (Eng): Pill list sounds good perf-wise. Role detection will require a lightweight inference at signup (account metadata + heuristics). Need to confirm privacy constraints. Lazy-load images for cards if we ship them. Also: pill scroll snap can be native CSS (fast).

Priya (Accessibility): Pill list needs careful keyboard affordance: arrow-key horizontal nav + accessible label for each pill. On mobile, long-press reveal is not keyboard friendly. Also consent toggle text must be clear and not buried inside the pill strip. Contrast: pill text on colored backgrounds should meet 4.5:1.

Sam (Growth): Personalization could lift conversion a lot if we get selection right. Suggest an explicit role-picker fallback in the strip: small "Not your role?" link that opens a role modal. For telemetry/consent: legal prefers opt-out? What are we proposing?

Leah (Legal): Important: telemetry/usage collection must be opt-in in many jurisdictions for analytics beyond product-improvement. If toggle is present in onboarding, default must be off and we need clear wording and link to privacy docs. Any automatic role inference must be disclosed.

Maya (PM): Ok — change: telemetry toggle must default OFF, wording: "Help improve templates (opt-in)." Add link to privacy. Role inference should be transparent with editable selection. Decision: compact pill by default, cards behind a "View details" CTA for those who want previews. Mobile: pill collapses into a single summary row with horizontal swipe.

Ivy (Design): Will update comps: pill states (selected / focused / visited), keyboard focus ring specs, and a micro-interaction for expanding a pill to a mini-preview. Also will add privacy link microcopy. Microcopy options for consent label:
- "Share anonymous usage to improve templates"
- "Help us improve templates (anonymous)"
Which reads clearer?

Priya (Accessibility): Prefer shorter: "Help improve templates (anonymous)". Also provide aria-describedby for the privacy link so screen reader users get context. Ensure the toggle has an accessible name and state announced.

Carlos (Eng): For role inference we'll add a server-side flag that expires after 7 days unless user confirms. Implementation plan: return suggested_role in /users/me, fallback to manual selection UI. Spike estimate: 2 dev days + 1 QA. Any objections?

Sam (Growth): A/B idea: show role picker for 25% of new accounts vs auto-suggest for 75%. Measure template adoption and time-to-first-project. Also log whether users toggled telemetry. Leah: we should include telemetry event category names in the privacy doc link.

Leah (Legal): Provide copy for the link. Also recommend a small banner to collect consent separately if analytics are expanded later.

Maya (PM): Action items: Ivy 1 update comps by Tue; Carlos 1 eng spike Mon; Priya 1 accessibility checklist for the strip; Sam 1 A/B plan + metrics; Leah 1 consent copy. @ConsoleBot create task DD-2810 and tag product/design/eng/growth/legal/accessibility.

ConsoleBot: Task created 1 DD-2810 "Personalized samples strip + consent toggle (compact pills)" 1 Assignees: Maya, Ivy, Carlos, Priya, Sam, Leah 1 Due: 2026-04-02

Ivy (Design): Quick Q: If the pill has an avatar/icon, should that be decorative or informative? Thinking: small role badge (developer/product) that doubles as tooltip.

Priya (Accessibility): Make icons informative with alt text and visible label fallback. Decorative-only icons should use role="img" aria-hidden="true" and still have text nearby.

Carlos (Eng): We'll expose alt text in the API payload and prefer SVG badges. Final note: ensure the pill strip is included in keyboard tab order before the final CTA in the setup checklist.
